title: Identifying Panel Conditioning with Refreshment Samples: Sharp Bounds and Design Assumptions
abstract: arXiv:2610.01654v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Refreshment samples are the standard remedy for panel attrition, and the identification results behind them maintain that participation does not change measurement. We characterize what a refreshment sample identifies about panel conditioning, modelled as a deterministic monotone map at reinterview, when attrition is unrestricted. A candidate map is consistent with the data if and only if the retention-scaled distribution of the stayers' implied latent outcomes is setwise dominated by the refreshment distribution; every such map is rationalized by an explicit attrition process. Without attrition the map is identified on the latent-outcome support; with attrition, a density-ratio condition governs the identified set, and tail behaviour alone does not determine it. For an unrestricted map the survivors' mean effect has the familiar trimming bounds; for an item with all categories reported, the model reduces to a test of no conditioning.

translated_title: 利用补充样本识别面板调节效应：紧界与设计假设
translated_abstract: 补充样本是应对面板流失的标准补救方法，其背后的识别结果假定参与调查不会改变测量结果。我们将面板调节效应建模为再访谈时的确定性单调映射，并刻画了在流失不受限制的情况下，补充样本能够对面板调节效应识别出什么。一个候选映射与数据相容，当且仅当留访者的隐含潜在结果的保留缩放分布在集合意义上被补充样本分布所支配；且每一个这样的映射都可以由一个显式的流失过程所合理化。在没有流失的情况下，该映射在潜在结果的支撑集上被识别；而在有流失的情况下，识别集由一个密度比条件所控制，仅凭尾部行为无法确定它。对于不受限制的映射，留访者的平均效应具有熟悉的修剪界；对于一个报告了所有类别的题项，该模型则简化为对“无调节效应”的检验。
tldr: 本文刻画了在流失不受限制时，补充样本对面板调节效应（建模为再访谈时的确定性单调映射）的识别能力：候选映射与数据相容当且仅当留访者潜在结果的保留缩放分布在集合意义上被补充样本分布所支配，识别集由密度比条件刻画，且每个相容映射都可由显式流失过程合理化。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes what refreshment samples identify about panel conditioning—modeled as a deterministic monotone map at reinterview—under unrestricted attrition, showing that a candidate map is data-consistent if and only if the retention-scaled distribution of stayers' latent outcomes is setwise dominated by the refreshment distribution, with the identified set governed by a density-ratio condition and every consistent map rationalized by an explicit attrition process.
